# Scott Persinger

> Hands-on product and engineering leader in San Francisco. Co-founder & CTO of BizTrip AI (agentic AI for corporate travel, backed by Andrew Ng's AI Fund); founder of Supercog AI; previously SVP Engineering at Tatari, manager of Alternative Payment Methods at Stripe, Senior Director of Platform Services at Heroku/Salesforce, and co-founder of Cloudconnect (acquired by Salesforce) and Remixation (acquired by Vevo). Computer Science, UC Berkeley.

Scott has led teams of 5-100 across fintech, ad tech, travel, consumer mobile, B2B SaaS, and cloud infrastructure. Current focus: agentic AI systems, AI-native development processes built around cloud coding agents, and enterprise-ready AI products (SOC 2, PCI DSS).
